workstreams.name: Conversion cost baseline
workstreams.answers: What is conversion cost per part at the Braga plant today, built up from cost data?
activities: Collect conversion cost data for the Braga plant
Build conversion cost per part from the cost data
Test the baseline with the people who run the plant

workstreams.name: Line loss analysis
workstreams.answers: On which production lines, and in which losses, does conversion cost build up at the Braga plant?
activities: Observe the production lines on the floor, two at a time
Quantify losses on each line from operational data
Interview the people who run each line about losses

workstreams.name: Improvement sizing
workstreams.answers: Which improvements can lower conversion cost per part by a measurable amount, and how much is each worth?
activities: List candidate improvements from the loss analysis
Size each one's effect on cost per part with cost data
Set out the sized list for the go/no-go decision

workstreams.name: Line improvement rollout
workstreams.answers: How are the chosen improvements put in place on the plant's lines, and in what order?
activities: Prepare each improvement with the people on the line
Show readiness at the first workshop before any go-live
Bring improvements to go-live, two at a time

workstreams.name: Cost per part tracking
workstreams.answers: Does conversion cost per part fall against the baseline as the improvements go live?
activities: Set up the cost-per-part tracker against the baseline
Read cost data on each line after every go-live
Report results against the baseline at each review

workstreams.name: Plant team capability
workstreams.answers: What must the plant team know and do to own the improvements after handover?
activities: Define what the plant team will own after handover
Train and coach plant staff on the running improvements
Hand the tracker and routines to the plant team

workstreams.name: Improvements in operation
workstreams.answers: Do the improvements keep running on the lines once live, without slipping back?
activities: Observe the improved lines in running operation
Check with line staff that the changes are still followed
Log slippage in operational data and agree fixes
